quota_name: AWS IoT devices per Greengrass group
description: The maximum number of AWS IoT devices per Greengrass V1 group.
The maximum size (in KB) of a Greengrass V2 component recipe.
The maximum number of Greengrass V2 components that you can create in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of characters in a Greengrass core device thing name. Core devices are AWS IoT things.

quota_name: Deployment document size (with large configuration support)
description: The maximum size (in MB) of a deployment document with large configuration support. The deployment document includes the component configurations, deployment configurations, and payload overhead.
The maximum number of Lambda functions per Greengrass V1 group.
The maximum number of API requests that you can send per second in this AWS account in the current Region. This quota applies to the combination of API requests for all control plane operations.
The maximum number of CreateComponentVersion requests that you can make per second in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of Greengrass V1 CreateDeployment requests that you can make per second in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of resources per Greengrass V1 group.
The maximum number of resources per Lambda function that runs on a Greengrass V1 core.
The maximum number of subscriptions per Greengrass V1 group.

quota_name: Subscriptions with 'cloud' message source per Greengrass group
description: The maximum number of subscriptions in a Greengrass V1 group that specify 'cloud' as the message source. The 'cloud' option represents AWS IoT.

quota_name: Thing deployment document size (without large configuration support)
description: The maximum size (in KB) of a deployment document for a Greengrass V2 thing deployment without large configuration support. The deployment document includes the component configurations, deployment configurations, and payload overhead.

quota_name: Thing group deployment document size (without large configuration support)
description: The maximum size (in KB) of a deployment document for a Greengrass V2 thing group deployment without large configuration support. The deployment document includes the component configurations, deployment configurations, and payload overhead.
The maximum total size (in GB) of all artifacts for a Greengrass V2 component version. This quota applies to the sum of all artifacts for a component version.
The maximum number of versions that you can create per Greengrass V2 component in this account in the current Region.
